hooks.command: python3 "$HOME/.claude/hooks/strip-claude-attribution.py"
b="$HOME/Library/Caches/claude-hooks/claude-hooks"; [ -x "$b" ] || b="$HOME/.local/bin/claude-hooks"; exec "$b" guard
[ -z "$HACHIKO_ONCALL_SESSION" ] || python3 "$HOME/.claude/hooks/oncall-guard.py" || exit 2
python3 "$HOME/.claude/hooks/herdr-tab-name.py"
python3 "$HOME/.claude/hooks/herdr-tab-name.py"
python3 "$HOME/.claude/hooks/herdr-tab-name.py"
bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/project-docs.sh"
bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/worktree-info.sh"
bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/herdr-tab-reset.sh"
bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/herdr-agent-state.sh" session

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
